descriptions.job-051ft8v:
The Opportunity

You'll be the operational backbone of a high-output team — the person who makes everything around them run. As Team Coordinator you'll own a wide surface area: from recruiting and onboarding to special projects that don't have a playbook yet, and whatever else needs doing to keep a fast-moving trading firm firing on all cylinders. This is a Swiss army knife role where the job description is "literally everything" — and you'll use AI-native tools and workflows to move at a pace that would be impossible otherwise. You'll partner directly with senior leaders, create clarity across stakeholders, and serve as the connective tissue between people, projects, and priorities. You'll thrive here if you're a people-person who gets energy from enabling others, a project manager who can hold ten threads at once, and someone with the ambiguity tolerance to take a vague ask and turn it into a done thing.

This is a genuine foot-in-the-door role for someone who wants a breakthrough career in finance and cares about being inside a fast-moving, tech-forward firm. You'll have real visibility, real ownership, and a steep learning curve — the kind of role where a fast learner with 3–5 years of experience can punch well above their weight.

Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end coordination of recruiting efforts on the operations side — sourcing, scheduling, candidate communication, pipeline tracking, and hiring manager support.

  • Drive special projects from ambiguous ask to completed deliverable — scoping requirements, building lightweight project plans, coordinating across stakeholders, and closing loops.

  • Serve as the primary point of contact and enabler for your team lead, anticipating needs, clearing blockers, and ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Use AI tools daily to accelerate your own output — drafting communications, summarizing research, building templates, automating repetitive workflows, and staying ahead of a high volume of work.

  • Create and maintain operational documentation, trackers, and lightweight systems that bring order to a fast-changing environment.

  • Coordinate across teams and functions to keep information flowing, deadlines visible, and stakeholders aligned — especially when priorities shift quickly.

  • Handle sensitive information with discretion and build trust as a reliable, people-first operator across the organization.

 

About you

  • You are a doer first — you get energy from checking things off, moving fast, and making the people around you more effective.

  • You are deeply people-oriented and customer-centric; you see your team leads and colleagues as your customers and you take pride in serving them well.

  • You have high ambiguity tolerance — you don't need a detailed brief to get started, and you're comfortable figuring things out as you go.

  • You are AI-first in how you work: you reach for AI tools instinctively to draft, research, organize, and move faster, not because you're told to but because it's how you operate.

  • You are highly organized and adaptive — you can hold many threads simultaneously and reprioritize without losing momentum when the ground shifts.

  • You are a fast learner who is genuinely curious about finance, markets, and how trading firms operate, even if you don't come from that world yet.

  • You are scrappy and resourceful — you've thrived in environments where the playbook didn't exist and you had to build it yourself.

  • You build strong working relationships quickly and communicate with clarity, warmth, and follow-through.

Preferred experience

  • 3–5 years of professional experience in operations, project management, chief of staff, or a generalist role at a fast-moving startup or high-output organization.

  • Demonstrated track record of managing multiple concurrent workstreams across stakeholders without dropping balls.

  • Hands-on, daily use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, or similar) to accelerate real work — not just experimentation, but integrated into how you operate.

  • Experience supporting recruiting processes: sourcing, scheduling, pipeline coordination, or candidate communication.

Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to synthesize ambiguity into clear action items and documentation.

About Nascent

Founded in 2020, Nascent exists to build, expand, and capture opportunity, in open markets and permissionless technologies. Building from a base of permanent capital, we deploy assets across a range of both liquid and long-term strategies that ensure we are among the most active users of the open financial system we are helping to build. We’ve backed 100+ early-stage teams that we believe can change markets and expand what’s possible. At Nascent, we combine that venture + market pedigree with product-grade engineering to turn research into revenue: experiments that ship fast, are evaluated rigorously, and move P&L. We focus on models, low-latency infrastructure, and resilient systems that compound performance over time.

Our Team & Culture

We’re an interdisciplinary team of engineers, quants, and operators who treat skill-building like a sport. The culture is competition + curiosity: push to win, share learnings, and iterate publicly through red-teams, internal games, and post-mortems. Autonomy isn’t a perk — it’s how we ship.

Principles that drive our team & work

  • Compete to win

  • Explore, experiment, play

  • Always be building

  • Seek and speak truth

  • Own your shit.

 

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to learn, experiment and build in an entrepreneurial environment

  • Competitive total comp with strong bonus upside tied to performance.

  • Hardware & home-office stipend, conference and learning budgets.

  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical/dental/vision), life insurance.

  • Open vacation policy as well as flexible work hours and location

  • 16 weeks fully-paid parental leave + supported return to work.

  • Retirement matching, open vacation policy, flexible hours.

 

We are an equal opportunity employer and welcome diverse perspectives.

descriptions.job-1nlode7:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Recruiting team builds Stripe’s culture by connecting exceptional talent with our highest-impact business needs. We bring Stripe’s operating principles to life through thoughtful, consistent hiring practices, a high-quality candidate experience, and data-informed partnership with the business.

What you’ll do

Stripe is looking for a consultative, creative recruiter to support critical Core Business functions. You will partner with senior leaders who shape Stripe’s financial strategy, external narrative, long-term growth, and company-wide decision-making.

This is a high-impact portfolio with varied talent markets, senior stakeholders, and roles where the quality of each hire can influence how Stripe operates and grows. You will own full-cycle recruiting, advise leaders on hiring strategy and market conditions, and build trusted relationships with candidates and hiring teams.

This is a 12 month fixed term contract and you are employed directly through Stripe.

Responsibilities

  • Partner with senior leaders to understand business priorities, define hiring plans, and develop recruiting strategies that support headcount goals.
  • Own the full recruiting lifecycle, from intake and sourcing through offer acceptance and onboarding handoff.
  • Advise hiring teams on talent-market conditions, candidate availability, competitive dynamics, and hiring approaches for specialized and senior roles.
  • Develop and execute sourcing strategies that build broad, qualified candidate pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
  • Build strong candidate relationships and deliver a thoughtful, timely candidate experience throughout the process.
  • Use recruiting data to track progress, identify risks and opportunities, and provide clear updates to business leaders.
  • Improve recruiting processes where needed, testing practical changes that help hiring teams move with clarity and consistency.
  • Partner closely with cross-functional teams, including Finance, People Operations, Benefits, Onboarding, and Legal, to support a smooth offer and onboarding experience.
  • Uphold structured, competency-based hiring practices and help hiring teams assess candidates against the requirements of each role.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • 4+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment, including in-house recruiting experience.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders on hiring strategy, talent-market insights, and complex searches.
  • Ability to build trust with senior stakeholders and influence decisions through sound judgment, data, and market knowledge.
  • Experience developing sourcing strategies and engaging candidates for specialized or senior roles.
  • Ability to use recruiting data to identify trends, communicate progress, and improve recruiting outcomes.
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple searches and shifting priorities.
  • A collaborative approach and comfort working across functions to solve problems and improve the hiring experience.
  • Curiosity about emerging AI tools and a practical approach to testing and adopting new ways of working.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience recruiting for business, corporate, finance, communications, strategy, legal, or other specialized professional functions.
  • Experience supporting senior-level hiring or roles with complex stakeholder groups.
  • Experience working across multiple geographies or advising on location strategy.
  • Familiarity with recruiting systems and sourcing tools, including applicant tracking systems, candidate relationship management tools, and LinkedIn Recruiter.

We invest in seed to venture to growth-stage technology companies, across AI, bio + healthcare, consumer, enterprise, fintech, frontier, games, and companies building toward American dynamism. a16z has $100B+ under management across multiple funds.

We’ve established a team that is defined by respect for the entrepreneur and the company-building process; we know what it’s like to be in the founder’s shoes. We’ve invested in companies like Anduril, Airbnb, Coinbase, Cursor, Databricks, Deel, Figma, GitHub, Roblox, SpaceX, and Stripe. Our team is at the forefront of new technology, helping founders and their companies impact and change the world.

The Executive Assistant will work closely with top-level Executives in New Media. This is an opportunity to work alongside leaders who are driven by excellence and a passion for technology. The ideal candidate is a team player with exceptional communication skills, meticulous attention to detail and creative problem-solving skills. 

This role supports General Partners, you will keep a demanding schedule running smoothly. Day to day, that means calendar management, coordinating meetings, travel and logistics, and prioritizing across competing requests from founders, guests, partners, and internal teams.   • Handle highly confidential information and documents with discretion and confidentiality

  • 5+ years of professional experience, ideally supporting senior-level executives in a fast-paced environment; we welcome candidates from nontraditional EA backgrounds
  • Expert-level scheduling and calendar management skills, including managing complex, shifting, multi-party schedules

  • Proactive, positive and personable with excellent communication skills and an upbeat, “can do” attitude- willing to take initiative with confidence

About Us

Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.
 
Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.
 
Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

Role Overview

This role sits within the Asset Operations team and is responsible for the full lifecycle management and operation of the platform’s digital assets, including new asset onboarding, post-listing maintenance, liquidity and risk monitoring, yield optimization, and asset value management. Through cross-functional collaboration (Wallet, Security, Finance, Compliance, Marketing, etc.), the role ensures assets run securely, yields stay stable, and visibility keeps growing.

Key Responsibilities

1. Asset Onboarding & Maintenance

  • Lead the evaluation, testing, and launch of new token and new chain assets, including mainnet deployment, parameter configuration, fee adjustment, and network verification
  • Continuously monitor asset operating status and coordinate with Wallet, Security, and Finance teams to keep the fund chain secure, positions sufficient, and operations stable

2. Post-Listing Asset Operations

  • Own post-listing operations and maintenance, including contract upgrades, token renaming, asset repricing, and announcements
  • Track ecosystem changes (mainnet upgrades, contract migrations, etc.), assess potential impact on the platform, and develop response plans

3. Risk Events & Emergency Response

  • Monitor, flag, and rapidly respond to asset-related risk events (network anomalies, price anomalies, contract issues, position gaps, etc.)
  • Coordinate Wallet, Security, and Finance teams to execute risk isolation and stop-loss measures
  • Lead post-incident reviews and process optimization; strengthen the emergency response mechanism and SOPs for asset operations

4. Process Management & Cross-functional Collaboration

  • Define and maintain standard processes (SOPs) for asset onboarding, maintenance, upgrades, and risk handling to improve overall execution efficiency
  • Coordinate Wallet, Security, Finance, Compliance, and Marketing teams to keep project progress and launch cadence on track
  • Regularly report asset operations metrics and project progress, and drive continuous process improvement

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or above; Finance, Economics, Blockchain, or related majors preferred. Familiarity with traditional securities and financial qualification certificates preferred
  • 2+ years of crypto asset operations or project management experience; familiar with major public chains, stablecoins, and RWA
  • Deep understanding of crypto user behavior, marketing mechanics, and asset value logic
  • Understanding of the digital asset regulatory framework and related compliance requirements
  • Data-driven mindset; able to independently analyze and report on metrics such as trading volume, AUM, and yield
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and execution skills; able to coordinate Tech, Security, Finance, and other teams to deliver projects
  • Fluent in Chinese and English (speaking, listening, reading, writing); able to communicate professionally with overseas project teams
  • Strong resilience under pressure and problem-solving ability; long-term passion and conviction for the crypto industry

Why Join Us
At Bybit, we are committed to fostering a supportive and enriching work environment. 
Our benefits include:
- Study Growth Fund: We support your professional development and continuous learning.
- Internal Events: Participate in regular team-building activities, workshops, and events designed to promote collaboration and innovation.
- Global Collaboration: Be part of a diverse, international team, working alongside colleagues from around the world.
- Career Advancement: Access opportunities for growth and advancement within a rapidly expanding global company.
- Internal Mobility: Grow with us- Your long-term development is important to us. We offer internal job opportunities to help build your career path.
